spots.name: Grand Lisboa

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Grand Lisboa is a 47-floor, 261-metre-tall (856 ft) hotel in Sé, Macau. It is owned and operated by Sociedade de Jogos de Macau and was designed by Hong Kong architects Dennis Lau and Ng Chun Man with the interiors created by Khuan Chew, Design Principal of KCA International.

spots.name: Ruins of Saint Paul's

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Ruins of Saint Paul's are the remnants of a 17th-century Catholic religious complex in Santo António, Macau. They include what was originally St. Paul's College and the Church of St. Paul, also known as "Mater Dei", a 17th-century Portuguese church dedicated to Saint Paul the Apostle.

spots.name: Macau Fisherman's Wharf
spots.summary: The Macau Fisherman's Wharf is a themed entertainment, retail and hotel complex and former amusement park in Sé, Macau, China.

spots.name: The Venetian Macao

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Venetian Macao is a hotel and casino resort in Macau, China owned by the American Las Vegas Sands company. The 39-storey structure on Macau's Cotai Strip has 10,500,000-square-foot (980,000 m2) of floor space, and is modeled on its sister casino resort The Venetian Las Vegas.

spots.name: Macau Tower

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Macau Tower Convention and Entertainment Center, also known as the Macau Tower, is a tower located in Sé, Macau. The tower stands 338 m (1,109 ft) high, from ground level to the highest point.

spots.name: A-Ma Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The A-Má Temple is a temple to the Chinese sea-goddess Mazu located in São Lourenço, Macau, China. Built in 1488, the temple is one of the oldest in Macau and thought to be the settlement's namesake.

spots.name: Wynn Macau
spots.summary: Wynn Macau is a luxury hotel and casino resort in Macau.

spots.name: Senado Square
spots.summary: The Senado Square, or Senate Square, is a paved town square in Sé, Macau, China, and part of the UNESCO Historic Centre of Macau World Heritage Site. It is an elongated triangular shaped square and connects Largo do São Domingos at one end and Avenida de Almeida Ribeiro on the other.

photo.author: Андрей Суриков / Andrey Surikov. Original uploader was Сура at ru.wikipedia

spots.name: Historic Centre of Macau
spots.summary: The Historic Centre of Macao is a collection of over twenty locations that witness the unique assimilation and co-existence of Chinese and Portuguese cultures in Macau, a former Portuguese colony.

spots.name: Galaxy Macau
spots.summary: Galaxy Macau is a casino resort located in Cotai, Macau. Construction on the Cotai project began in 2002. Its opening was rescheduled several times. Galaxy Entertainment Group's developer announced on 10 March 2011 that the HKD 14.9 billion resort would officially open on 15 May 2011.

spots.name: Rua do Cunha
spots.summary: Rua do Cunha is a narrow pedestrian street in Vila da Taipa, the town centre of Taipa, Macau. The street is named after Pedro Alexandrino da Cunha, a Portuguese navy captain who was the 81st Governor of Macau.

spots.name: Fortaleza do Monte
spots.summary: The Fortaleza do Monte is a fort in Santo António in Macau. It is the historical military centre of Macau. The fort forms part of the "Historic Centre of Macau" and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

spots.name: Portas do Cerco
spots.summary: The Portas do Cerco is an area in Nossa Senhora de Fátima, Macau, China. Located on the northern tip of the Macau Peninsula, it is known by the Barrier Gate separating Macau from mainland China. The Portuguese built the gate in 1849 to replace a crumbling wall that the Chinese erected during the Ming dynasty in 1573.

spots.name: Cotai Strip
spots.summary: The Cotai Strip is an area known mostly for its hotel-casinos in the central portion of Cotai, Macau. The term was coined by the Las Vegas Sands Corporation in reference to its construction of a strip.

spots.name: St. Dominic's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Saint Dominic's Church is a late 16th-century Baroque-style church that serves within the Cathedral Parish of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Macau. It is in the peninsular part of the city at the Largo de São Domingos, near the Leal Senado Building.

spots.name: Lotus Bridge
spots.summary: Lotus Bridge is a cross-border bridge linking the Cotai reclamation area of Macau with Hengqin Island in Zhuhai, Guangdong, mainland China. The bridge is a road crossing between mainland China and Macau. Since December 2014, it has been open 24 hours per day.

spots.name: Avenida de Almeida Ribeiro
spots.summary: Avenida de Almeida Ribeiro, also commonly known as San Ma Lou, is the main avenue in the heart of Macau Peninsula. The 620 metres long avenue was laid out in 1920 and it extends from the Inner to the Outer harbour, passing through the old residential area with its rows of colourful street shops.

spots.name: Macao Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Macao Museum is a public museum located on the hill of the Fortaleza do Monte in Santo António, Macau SAR. The museum presents the history of the city and territory of the former Portuguese colony of Macau, now a special administrative region of the People's Republic of China.

spots.name: Bank of China Building

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Bank of China Building is the ninth tallest building in Macau. At 38 floors and 163 metres (535 ft) tall, it was designed by P&T Architects & Engineers Ltd and is home to the Bank of China operations in Macau. Construction started in 1989 and was completed in 1991.

spots.name: Lou Lim Ioc Garden
spots.summary: Lou Lim Ioc Garden is a garden in São Lázaro in Macau. Built in 1906 by local merchant Lou Kau as part of his residence, the garden has a design that follows the well-known Suzhou Gardens. It was turned over to the Macau government in 1974 as a public park, which is popular with local inhabitants.

spots.name: St Lawrence's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Lawrence's Church is one of the oldest churches in Macau, China. It is located on Rua de São Lourenço, opposite Instituto Salesiano.

spots.name: Studio City

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Studio City is an integrated resort on the Cotai Strip in Cotai, Macau. The Hollywood studio-themed leisure resort is the first in Asia to integrate television and film production facilities, retail, gaming and hotels.

spots.name: Leal Senado Building
spots.summary: The Leal Senado Building was the seat of Portuguese Macau's government. It is located at one end of the Senado Square in São Lourenço, Macau, China. It currently houses Macau's Municipal Affairs Bureau.

spots.name: Sun Yat Sen Memorial House

hours.note: Closed Tue

spots.summary: Sun Yat Sen Memorial House or Memorial House of Dr. Sun Yat Sen is a museum located in São Lázaro, Macau, China where former family members and relatives of Sun Yat-sen, the 'Father of Modern China' used to live.

spots.name: Mandarin's House

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mandarin's House is a historic residential complex in São Lourenço, Macau. It was the residence and family home of the late Qing theoretician and reformist Zheng Guanying (1842–1921). He completed his masterpiece Shengshi Weiyan in the house.

spots.name: St. Joseph's Seminary and Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The St. Joseph's Seminary and Church is a seminary and church located in São Lourenço, Macau, China.

spots.name: Na Tcha Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Na Tcha Temple, built in 1888, is a Chinese folk religion temple in Santo António, Macau, a special administrative region of China. It is dedicated to the worship of the popular Deity Na Tcha (哪吒) or Sam Tai Tsz (三太子).

spots.name: Guia Lighthouse
spots.summary: The Guia Fortress is a 17th-century colonial military fort, chapel, and lighthouse complex in São Lázaro, Macau. The complex is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site Historic Centre of Macau.

spots.name: Sam Kai Vui Kun

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Sam Kai Vui Kun, known also as Kuan Tai Temple, is located in front of St. Dominic's Market Complex, near Senado Square in Sé, Macau, China. The temple was built in 1750.

spots.name: Grand Prix Museum

hours.note: Closed Tue

spots.summary: The Grand Prix Museum is a motor racing museum in Sé, Macau, China. The museum was inaugurated at the 40th Macau Grand Prix on 18 November 1993.

spots.name: Igreja da Sé

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of the Nativity of Our Lady also Sé Catedral da Natividade de Nossa Senhora and Igreja da Sé is a Roman Catholic cathedral in Sé, Macau. It is the current cathedral of the Diocese of Macau. The cathedral is also called the "Church of the Nativity of Our Lady".
spots.wikipediaTitle: Cathedral of the Nativity of Our Lady, Macau

spots.name: Macau Government Headquarters

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Macau Government Headquarters, formerly Governor's Palace is the official office of the Chief Executive of Macau and has been since 1999. It is located in São Lourenço.

spots.name: Kun Iam Temple

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Kun Iam Temple is a Chinese Buddhist temple in Nossa Senhora de Fátima, Macau, China. One of the three largest and richest Buddhist temples in Macau, its more official name is Pou Chai Sim Un.

spots.name: Guia Fortress
spots.summary: The Guia Fortress is a 17th-century colonial military fort, chapel, and lighthouse complex in São Lázaro, Macau. The complex is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site Historic Centre of Macau.

spots.name: Camoes Garden
spots.summary: Luís de Camões Garden is a public park in Santo António, Macau. Established in the 19th century on the grounds of a former 18th-century estate, the garden spans over 26,063 square metres (280,540 sq ft).

spots.name: Santa Casa da Misericórdia
spots.summary: The Holy House of Mercy of Macau, is a historic building in Senado Square, Sé, Macau. Established as a branch of the Santa Casa da Misericórdia, it was first built in 1569 on the orders of the Bishop of Macau, Belchior Carneiro Leitão.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Santa Casa da Misericórdia of Macau

spots.name: One Central

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One Central in Sé, Macau is a waterfront mixed-used project developed by Hongkong Land and Shun Tak Holdings and completed in 2009.

spots.name: Seac Pai Van Park
spots.summary: The Seac Pai Van Park is a park in Coloane, Macau, China. It is the largest natural green area in Macau and is administered by the Civil and Municipal Affairs Bureau.

spots.name: St. Augustine's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Established by the Spanish Augustinians in 1591, this church maintains the tradition of organising the Easter Procession around the city.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Macau Mosque and Cemetery
spots.summary: The Macau Mosque and Cemetery is the only mosque and Muslim cemetery in Macau, China, located in the parish of Nossa Senhora de Fátima.

spots.name: Lotus Square
spots.summary: The Lotus Square or Golden Lotus Square is an open square in Sé, Macau, China. The area features the large bronze sculpture Lotus Flower In Full Bloom and is somewhat akin to the Golden Bauhinia of neighbouring Hong Kong.

spots.name: Tap Seac Square
spots.summary: Tap Seac Square is a major public square in São Lázaro, Macau. It stood on the site of a former stadium and was completed in 2007. Amongst others, the buildings of the Macau Central Library, the Cultural Institute and the Macau Historic Archives are located around the square.

spots.name: Taipa Houses–Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Taipa Houses–Museum is housed in a set of old houses in Taipa, Macau, China.

spots.name: Macau Museum of Art

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Macau Museum of Art is an art museum in Sé, Macau established on 19 March 1999.

spots.name: Our Lady of Carmel Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Our Lady of Carmel Church is a church located on the island of Taipa, Macau, China.

spots.name: St. Anthony's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of Macau's oldest churches, the first structure was built of wood and bamboo. The current structure was constructed in 1930.

spots.name: Maritime Museum

hours.note: Closed Tue

spots.summary: The Maritime Museum is a museum in São Lourenço, Macau, China.

spots.name: Red Market
spots.summary: The Almirante Lacerda Municipal Market, popularly known as the Red Market, is a three-story wet market building in Santo António, Macau, China.

spots.name: Amizade Bridge
spots.summary: The Amizade Bridge is a four-lane, two-way bridge in Macau that connects Macau Peninsula near the Reservatório and Taipa Island.

spots.name: St. Augustine's Square
spots.summary: This square is fronted by various pretty buildings of Macau's past era, namely the St Augustine's Church, Dom Pedro V Theatre, St Joseph's Seminary and Church and the Robert Ho Tung Library.

spots.name: Largo do Lilau
spots.summary: Pretty little square surrounded by the old Mediterranean-style houses of one of Macau's oldest residential areas. The square has a spring where it is said that "One who drinks from Lilau never forgets Macau".

spots.name: Old Protestant Cemetery
spots.summary: The Old Protestant Cemetery is a cemetery in Santo António, Macau, China. It was established by the British East India Company in 1821 in Portuguese Macau in response to a lack of burial sites for Protestants in the Roman Catholic Portuguese colony.

photo.author: No machine-readable author provided. Glio~commonswiki assumed (based on copyrigh

spots.name: Dom Pedro V Theatre
spots.summary: The Dom Pedro V Theatre is a historical theatre situated at Largo de Santo Agostinho in São Lourenço, Macau, China. It is one of the first western-style theatres in East Asia. The theater is an important landmark in the region and remains a venue for important public events and celebrations today.

spots.name: Penha Hill
spots.summary: The Penha Hill is a hill in São Lourenço, Macau, China.

spots.name: Lou Kau Mansion
spots.summary: Built in 1889, this was the home of Lou Kau, a prominent Chinese merchant who owned several properties in the city. The architecture is that of a typical Chinese residential building.

spots.name: Rua da Felicidade
spots.summary: The old red light district. Today it is a fairly interesting shopping street, with various antiques and handicrafts, and is also popular with movie makers: the Shanghai Nightclub car chase scene from Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom was filmed here, including parts of the main street, Avenida de Almeida Ribeiro.

spots.name: Kun Iam Statue
spots.summary: Twenty metre high bronze statue of the Goddess of Mercy emerging from a lotus floating in the Outer Harbour. The statue is connected to land by a 60 m footbridge.
